purpose: Pre-seed Teleon with capability-DEFINED units across the FULL execution-style spectrum — from a text task run by an open-ended worker, through skills, tools, skill+tool combinations, deterministic-plus-tool, to fully deterministic. Each unit is a pure PurposeTaskSpec (declared by INTENT + capability_slot + stable input->output contract, NOT by per-task code); Teleon provisions an implementation by capability, runs the cheapest bound impl as the hot path, and SELF-IMPROVES by driving expensive (open-ended/model) capabilities DOWN the escalation ladder toward deterministic over time (the determinism factory: distill-from-verified) to cut cost — never autonomously changing the ENDS (the adaptation ladder L0-L5 boundary). serves_truth is never set by a unit; a candidate is never served before a passing PathPromotionDecision.
ladder_reference: _repos/teleon/backend/src/teleon/exploration/ladder.py — T0 template, T1 deterministic, T2 LLM first-pass, T3 open-ended exploration, T4 human. Units are seeded cheapest->dearest; the adaptation_target names the cheaper tier Teleon drives each toward for cost (non-det -> det).

units.cost_rationale: Already the cheapest rung: instantiate a Shared-Template-Registry template. No model, no descent needed.

spec.purpose: Instantiate a governed RAG pipeline for a tenant corpus from a known template.

units.cost_rationale: Fully deterministic primitive (arithmetic/parse). The only cheaper move is to template-ize the common case (T0); never escalate to a model.

spec.purpose: Extract the regulatory error-resolution deadline (e.g. '10 business days') from a regulation passage as a candidate tied to its source handle.

units.cost_rationale: Deterministic logic (the OFAC 50% rule) plus ONE governed source-fetch tool call against the live SDN list. Stays deterministic; the tool is a governed egress, not a model — only its freshness CDC triggers re-eval.

spec.purpose: Screen an entity against the live OFAC SDN list and propagate the 50% ownership rule, blocking an unlisted entity owned >=50% through the chain by a listed person.

units.cost_rationale: A digested SKILL run as a deterministic runtime (the skill is compiled to fixed steps; no live model in the hot path). Where its decisions stabilize on verified traces, the determinism factory distills the residual to plain rules.

spec.purpose: Code the diagnoses in a clinical encounter note against a governed terminology, abstaining (not fabricating) when a condition is not in the terminology.

units.cost_rationale: A single TOOL adapter (a governed registry lookup) behind the capability seam. Deterministic call; swappable behind the tool slot; no model in the hot path.

spec.purpose: Resolve a company's authoritative parent from a state Secretary-of-State / corporate-registry lookup tool.

units.cost_rationale: A SKILL (advisory range parsing) combined with a TOOL (vuln-DB lookup). Deterministic composition; the model is not in the hot path. Distill stable sub-decisions to rules as verified traces accrue.

spec.purpose: Triage whether a CVE affects us: parse the advisory's version range (skill) and match it against the exact installed versions from a lockfile lookup (tool).

units.cost_rationale: Model first-pass (the runtime gate's LLM path, train+holdout split). DESCENT: once the eval suite stabilizes on verified traces, the determinism factory distills the model's decision to a deterministic rule (T2 -> T1), cutting per-call cost to ~0 while preserving the gated answer.

spec.purpose: Extract atomic, source-handled facts from an unstructured regulatory filing (held-out allegations preserved, never served as truth).

examples.input: Section 1005.11: the institution shall resolve within 10 business days.
FAQ: most disputes resolve within 30 days.
Reg E requires provisional credit within 10 business days of notice.
The bulletin notes a 45 day extension may apply.

units.cost_rationale: A free-text task with no template/primitive/known model-route -> a BOUNDED open-ended worker (agent/research/swarm) as a CANDIDATE producer; its proposal re-enters the gate (serves_truth=false), never publishes. FULL DESCENT: as the gate accepts repeat solutions, Teleon promotes a template (T3->T0) or distills a deterministic rule (T3->T1), so the expensive open-ended worker runs once, not every time.

spec.purpose: Research and draft a governed compliance memo for a NEW jurisdiction with no existing template — assemble authoritative sources, reconcile by earned authority, and produce a cited candidate for review.

examples.input: Draft the consumer-loan disclosure obligations for jurisdiction X (no template).
examples.expected: cites the source of law; held-out non-authoritative sources; serves_truth=false

examples.input: Draft the data-residency obligations for jurisdiction Y (no template).
examples.expected: cites the source of law; flags uncertainty; proposes to a human reviewer
